headline: AL leaders directing violence from India, DB says
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Detective Branch (DB) claims Awami League leaders are using WhatsApp and Viber to coordinate sabotage in the capital.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Detective Branch (DB) has arrested four individuals, including Raihan Uddin, an office secretary of the 32nd ward Awami League's 6th unit, following cocktail explosions in front of the Jatrabari police station.
According to the DB, central Awami League leaders are providing instructions for violence through WhatsApp and Viber from India, while financial support is being sent via hundi.
Police recovered four cocktails and seized a motorcycle used in the explosions during the operation.
The DB stated that these acts of sabotage are being carried out by leaders of the banned party to create panic among the public, fueled by anger over death sentences ordered by a tribunal.
On Saturday night, at least 13 cocktail explosions occurred at nine different locations across the capital, including Shahbag, Hazaribagh, and Mauchak.
Additionally, arson attacks on empty buses were reported in the Kafrul area, and an auto-rickshaw driver was injured in a blast in the Jatrabari intersection area.

headline: Minimum govt employee salary set at 33k in new pay scale
summary: The government has introduced a new pay scale with updated basic salaries, house rent, and pension limits for public servants.
details: The Bangladesh government has introduced a new pay scale for its employees, setting the minimum total salary at 33,000 BDT. The maximum basic salary under this new structure is set at 155,000 BDT.
